The proportion of respondents who indicated that Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs) were not at all considered in their ML-enabled system projects is approximately 0.634, with a 95% confidence interval ranging from 0.580 to 0.692. This suggests that a significant portion of respondents perceive NFRs as not being adequately addressed in their ML projects, which may have implications for the overall success and reliability of these systems.
